name: vlan-change
title: Record a network change
description: Writes the before and after into the change log, updates the inventory, and writes a handoff that includes the rollback steps.
say: Record tonight's VLAN 20 change and leave a note for the morning.

inputs.name: project
inputs.prompt: Which project keeps the change log?

steps.title: Add it to the change log
Update the inventory
steps.prompt: Update the network inventory notes for this change: {{inputs.change}} Show the person what you changed.

steps.title: Write the morning handoff with the rollback steps
steps.prompt: Write the handoff for the morning engineer with /gt:gt-create handoff. Include the change ({{inputs.change}}) and the rollback steps ({{inputs.rollback}}).
